incident-bot: ALERT: High P99 latency + error spike for hosted text-gen in eu-west. Smart routing shows economy lane overloaded. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/latency :rotating_light:
henry: paging oncall. @maria are you up for triage?
maria: I’m on. joining now. any mitigation in place?
henry: ops set a temporary rate-limit on economy-tier eu-west to 50r/s but load is spilling into standard and causing P95 to climb. thinking we should steer economy -> dedicated or pause economy steering entirely.
lucas: I can push a routing toggle to block economy steering for eu-west for 10m. running: `/api/orch/route/steer --region eu-west --tier-block economy --ttl 600`
ajay: bumped dedicated quota for eu-west by +20% to accept diverted traffic (eu-west-dedicated pool).
maria: quick customer impact check: ~0.8% of total requests are resulting in 4xx/timeout, mainly free-tier completions. no enterprise SLAs flagged so far.
cxsupport: ACME reported timeouts ~5m ago, I told them we’re investigating and doing mitigations. will update.
henry: also enabling model-variant fallback for long completions to reduce token pressure: `/modelset switch --route long-gen --variant fast-quant`
lucas: patch applied. P50 improved, P95 still elevated but trending down.
maria: running smart-weight adjustment now — setting economy weight to 0 for eu-west, eu-central, ap-south for 15m window: `curl -XPOST https://api.internal/route/weights -d '{"region":"eu-west","weights":{"economy":0}}'`
ajay: enabled additional prefix-KV caching for common prompts in eu-west cache layer to cut repeated generation.
ops-bot: NOTE: Autoscaler triggered +2 dedicated nodes in eu-west-dedicated (scale event id: scale-20240305-77).
lucas: monitoring logs. seeing fewer long tail requests but some retries from SDKs are amplifying load. we should add short-term per-key rate limits for anonymous keys.
henry: agreed. plan: 1) disable economy steering (done) 2) increase dedicated capacity (done) 3) apply short-term rate-limits for anonymous/low-tier keys 4) monitor and rollback after stable for 10m. @maria you own rollback?
maria: yep. I’ll watch metrics and roll back after 10m of stable P95/P99. tagging runbook entry.
cxsupport: messaging ACME: "We routed your traffic to dedicated capacity and applied temporary limits. We're monitoring; next update in 20m."
henry: please add all commands used to the incident ticket. I’ll keep pager open until rollback completes.
incident-bot: MONITOR: error-rate back to baseline, P95 within SLO for 4 minutes. recommend wait 15m then close.
maria: copy, will close if stable in 12m. :thumbsup:
lucas: leaving a note in the routing runbook about the new steer-toggle and fallback variant.
henry: thanks team — great coordination.
